title: Stalin urges CM Vijay to heed women’s protest over rising prices, law and order

ai.summary: DMK president M.K. Stalin urged Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay to address women's protests over rising prices and law and order concerns, citing increased crime against women and economic hardship.

facts.claim: DMK president M.K. Stalin urged Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay to heed the wake-up call given by the DMK’s women’s wing
facts.quote: DMK president M.K. Stalin on Saturday (October 31, 2026) said Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay should heed the wake-up call given by the DMK’s women’s wing, which organised a demonstration highlighting the deteriorating law and order situation and spiralling prices of essential commodities.

facts.claim: The women have rung the bell
facts.quote: The women have rung the bell. The government, which is hunting down its critics and preparing for a show in the byelection, should pay attention to governance,

facts.claim: The poor in the State were groping in the dark in the wake of an unprecedented rise in the prices of essential commodities
facts.quote: He said the poor in the State were groping in the dark in the wake of an unprecedented rise in the prices of essential commodities.

facts.claim: Women are angry over the steep hike in electricity bills and the prices of provisions
